GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2014-07-30T19:10:07Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Is it possible to use CamelCase in model definition, and snake_case in DB?
Description: Title says it all.

I want my models to look like this (in livescript):

``` livescript
User = db.define \User, {
  id:
    type: db.INTEGER
    primary-key: yes

  first-name:
    type: db.STRING

  last-name:
    type: db.STRING

  middle-name:
    type: db.STRING

  username:
    type: db.STRING

  email:
    type: db.STRING

  nickname:
    type: db.STRING

  password-hash:
    type: db.STRING

  gender:
    type: db.ENUM \male, \female

  date-of-birth:
    type: db.DATE

}
```

but my DB schema to look like this:

``` sql
CREATE TABLE public.users ( 
    id Integer DEFAULT nextval('users_id_seq'::regclass) NOT NULL UNIQUE
    , first_name Character Varying( 255 )
    , last_name Character Varying( 255 )
    , middle_name Character Varying( 255 )
    , nickname Character Varying( 255 )
    , date_of_birth Timestamp With Time Zone
    , created_at Timestamp With Time Zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL
    , updated_at Timestamp With Time Zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL
    , gender public.gender
    , email Character Varying( 2044 ) NOT NULL
    , username Character Varying( 2044 ) NOT NULL
    , password_hash Character Varying( 2044 ) NOT NULL
    , PRIMARY KEY ( id )
    , CONSTRAINT users_username_key UNIQUE( username )
    , CONSTRAINT users_email_key UNIQUE( email ) 
);
```
